summary: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform Cloud API for sending and receiving customer messages and calls.
access_note: Meta developer registration gives a test number and temporary token; production needs a permanent system-user token, a business portfolio and verification.
blocker_note: Multi-tenant use requires Meta app review/business verification and messaging is template-restricted outside the 24-hour window.

evidence.quote: Authentication uses OAuth (not 2.0) access tokens, while permissions restrict access to specific resources.
Add a To phone number that will receive the test message.
The WhatsApp Business Platform is built on Graph API and uses HTTP protocol.
This release is built for development and testing workflows, not production sending at scale.

notes: Meta's WhatsApp Business Tools MCP is aimed at setup/testing, not a general messaging toolkit; its documentation page URL was taken from the blog and not opened. App review requirement inferred from Meta platform norms plus the overview's business verification mention. Some quotes from fetch-tool excerpts.
